name: Cryonic-Crucible
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near magnetic pole anomalies that no expedition has ever claimed.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on platinum and silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
